name: Archer Guard
description: A tall guard bearing a longbow and quiver with arrows fletched in the settlement’s colors.

abilities.name: Hobbling Shot
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 1d12+3 physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they have disadvantage on Agility Rolls until they clear at least 1 HP.
